description: §7.3.5 — three unread local bindings in one function body, each W-UNUSED-BINDING (a Warning): an unread `const`, a write-only `let` (assigned, never read), and an unread iterate-head binder. The program compiles; the warnings do not change it.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — unused-binding lint code: W-UNUSED-BINDING (S479, 2026-11-18)" · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S422 "CALL 3 — unused-binding is a LINT across all binding forms, hard error later if it proves out"
rationale: §7.3.5: "Any local binding — `let`, `const` or keywordless (§50.8.5) — that is not read before its scope ends SHALL be reported as W-UNUSED-BINDING, a Warning"; "A binding that is only assigned is not read, so it is reported"; the iterate-head binder is covered (§49.3.5: "A keywordless binder … is `const`"). One report per binding.

codes: severity:code 'W-UNUSED-BINDING' did not fire (expected severity warning)
